Rina (PM): quick thread: need to finalize GA scope for the Console Observability bundle. main asks: dashboard templates, tracing hooks for hot-paths, per-route cost estimates, and an error analytics drilldown.
Omar (Eng): high-level: tracing hooks + cost estimate surface = 2 sprints. dashboards gallery + one-click apply = 1 sprint. error RCA links = 1 sprint. assumptions: default sampling 5%, retention 7d.
Hannah (SRE): operations constraints: must include throttles and auto-fallback to summary traces when ingestion > quota. will add SLO targets.
Luis (Design): gallery: ship 3 templates for GA; include space for sampling & sample-size indicator. can deliver mocks in 3 days.
Tasha (CS): customers want per-route spend (estimated) and a CSV export for finance. include export in GA asks.
Rina (PM): proposed beta acceptance: 1) 3 beta customers signoff, 2) dashboard median load <200ms, 3) trace join success >97%, 4) per-route cost median error <7%.
Omar (Eng): config excerpt we plan to use:
```
tracing:
  default_sample_rate: 0.05
  hot_path_override: 0.9
  retention_days: 7
```
Omar (Eng): note: enterprise customers want 14d + per-tenant overrides; recommend Dedicated-only for that.
Hannah (SRE): infra-bot: current deploy queue length 6, will widen canary window. infra-bot: queue:6 avg_wait:2m.
Rina (PM): action owners: Omar -> sampling + throttle behavior doc by Fri. Luis -> gallery mocks by Thu. Hannah -> SLOs + rollback criteria by Mon. Tasha -> beta list + export copy by Mon. I'll collate and update roadmap.
Tasha (CS): will reach out to 4 customers for beta invites.
Rina (PM): final Q: do we show "throttled" as a distinct state in cost UI? seems necessary.
Omar (Eng): yes, show throttled with badge and sample-size note.
Rina (PM): good. closing — will follow up with a short meeting invite after docs land. :white_check_mark:
